**4. Flows / positioning:** From prior context, XLP saw first inflows since February (~$551M), BofA defensive rotation advocated. **5. Earnings/policy catalysts:** **Walmart reports Aug 20** (Q2 FY27) — the biggest XLP holding, a key catalyst this week. Target and Home Depot also report this week.
